notes:
I couldn't do any research for Psalm 52, so I have no commentary notes to give you. My one attempt to open the sources (Enduring Word, Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub, Precept Austin, Augustine on New Advent, and the NET Bible notes) was blocked by a tool-use limit before any page loaded, and the tool won't let me try again in this turn.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and give a URL for every point, so I haven't written notes from memory. They would have no sources behind them.

If you send the request again in a new message, I'll start with those pages and then look for:
- Spurgeon's *Treasury of David* (spurgeon.org or Bible Hub)
- Wesley's notes (wesley.nnu.edu)
- Catholic and Orthodox readings (catholic.com, oca.org)
- Any pages on these sites that discuss popular modern teaching on verse 7 (trusting in wealth) or verse 8 (the flourishing olive tree)

Then I'll write the notes verse by verse with a URL after each point, and leave out anything I can't find.
